fields.description: The option students/staff pick in the Purpose field of a Fee Certificate Request.
fields.label: Purpose

fields.description:
Controls which fee figures go into the table.
Multi Year Fee Structure – one column for every year of the programme from the student's first year (future years repeat the per-annum fees; Admission Fee only in year 1).
Single Year Fee Demand – one academic year, fee to be paid (Admission Fee only in the student's first year).
Single Year Fee Receipt – one academic year, fee already paid.
fields.label: Certificate Type
fields.options:
Multi Year Fee Structure
Single Year Fee Demand
Single Year Fee Receipt

fields.label: Download Only When Fully Paid
fields.description: Students can download this certificate from the student portal only when they have no outstanding fee (all their Fee Demands are fully paid).

Placeholders you can use in the texts below: {{ student_name }}, {{ student_id }}, {{ admit_card_number }}, {{ application_number }}, {{ registration_id }}, {{ programme }}, {{ programme_duration }} (e.g. "five years"), {{ academic_year }} (e.g. "2026-27"), {{ current_year }} (year of study, e.g. "II"), {{ year_fee }} (that year's Total fee payable), {{ due_year }} / {{ due_academic_year }} (the first year from the certificate year that still has fee outstanding, e.g. "II" / "2027-28"), {{ paid_summary }} (year-wise paid amount lines), {{ institute_name }}, {{ bank_account_name }}, {{ bank_account_no }}, {{ bank_ifsc_code }}, {{ bank_branch }}.
fields.label: Certificate Content
Body Text (Admission Stage)
fields.description: Used instead of Body Text when the certificate is for an applicant (Certificate For = Admission Stage). Extra placeholders: {{ admit_card_number }}, {{ application_number }}.

fields.default: Academic Year {{ academic_year }} paid amount is Rs. {{ fee_amount }}/-
fields.description: One line per academic year the student has studied so far (up to the certificate's academic year), printed wherever {{ paid_summary }} appears in the Body Text. Placeholders: {{ academic_year }} (e.g. "2025-2026"), {{ fee_amount }} (the year's overall Total from the table, after any University Scholarship), {{ paid_amount }} (amount actually paid so far).
fields.label: Year-wise Paid Amount Line
Show Paid / Outstanding Rows
fields.description: Multi-year certificates for campus students: adds a paid row (amounts in brackets) and an outstanding row under the total. Not shown for applicants.
Optional closing paragraph / note printed after the table (and bank details).
fields.label: Closing Text
